scope: Read-only signed installation baseline versus fixed imported update candidate; bounded content/permission changes; strict management API.

No new Web or native platform acceptance is claimed; M30 embedded UI is reused.
Update staging/commit/recovery/UI, remote version checks, old-state writer prevention and remaining personal/LAN tasks stay pending.
